exposure: Acute placental reaction to meconium (acute exposure group)
Continuous placental exposure to meconium (continuous exposure group)
outcome: Time between rupture of membranes and delivery
Non-reassuring fetal heart rate in labor
cohort: The study included 294 singleton deliveries complicated by meconium stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) at a single university-affiliated medical center between 2008 and 2018.
finding: Acute histological changes of MSAF were independently associated with adverse neonatal outcomes compared to continuous histological MSAF.
